fields.body_md:
## About this programme

Thinking of an MSc in data science at Southampton? Here is what it costs, who can get in and the 2027 deadline.

The Southampton MSc Data Science is a one-year, full-time course at the Highfield campus. It starts in September 2027. You study techniques including data mining, machine learning and data visualisation.

**The most important fact for you:** you need a 2:1 in computer science or a closely related subject, with set programming and maths modules. Indian applicants need between **55%** and **65%**, depending on their institution's tier.

Southampton says it offers one of the only data science master's programmes in the UK that covers every subject needed to become a skilled data scientist in industry, government or academia.

For the wider university, see our [University of Southampton page](/study-abroad/universities/university-of-southampton).

## Can you get in?

**Degree.** You need a 2:1 in computer science or a closely related subject: computer engineering, software engineering, mathematics/statistics or physics. You must also have a 2:1 in one programming module and one advanced maths module, ideally statistics and probability.

**Indian marks.** For postgraduate taught courses, Southampton asks for a UK 2:1 equivalent with an average of between **55%** and **65%**, depending on the awarding institution. Each Indian institution sits in a tier: for a 2:1 you need **60%** at a Tier 1 institution, **65%** at Tier 2 and **70%** at Tier 3. A 2:1 is a UK honours grade. Southampton has a searchable list of Indian institutions so you can find your tier.

**Personal statement.** You must submit a personal statement. References are not required.

**GRE.** The course page does not mention GRE. GRE is a US-style graduate admissions test.

**English.** IELTS is an English language test. You need **IELTS 6.5** overall with **6.0** in reading, writing, speaking and listening.

**ATAS.** ATAS (Academic Technology Approval Scheme) is a UK security clearance that some science and technology courses need before you get a visa. Southampton's course page does not say whether this course needs it. Ask the admissions team when you get your offer. If it is needed, an ATAS application takes at least **30 working days**.

## What it costs

Tuition for international students is **£36,800** for a year's study, for the 2027 entry year. The course lasts 1 year.

Southampton is outside London, so the outside-London visa rule applies. This is the worked first-year total.

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Tuition for international students, the 2027 entry year | £36,800 |
| Living money you must show for your visa: £1,171 × 9 months | £10,539 |
| Student visa application fee, from outside the UK | £558 |
| Immigration Health Surcharge for a visa of just over a year | £1,164 |
| **Total** | **£49,061** |

The sum is £36,800 + £10,539 + £558 + £1,164 = £49,061. Travel and housing are not included.

**Living money is money you show, not a fee.** The visa rule is **£1,171** for each month of your course outside London, up to **9 months**. You must hold this money for **28 days** in a row. The 28-day period must end within **31 days** of the date you apply. You do not pay it to the university.

**Health surcharge.** The Immigration Health Surcharge (IHS) is a charge for using the NHS while you are in the UK. It is set by the length of your visa, not your course. For a course of 12 months or longer, the visa adds up to **1 month** before and **4 months** after the course. That makes a visa of more than a year but under 18 months. You then pay the yearly **£776** plus half of it, **£388**, so **£1,164**.

**Deposit.** International students on a full-time course pay **£2,000** of their tuition fees in advance, before a CAS is issued. Your offer letter gives the date and terms. The deposit is part of the tuition, so it is not added to the total. There is no application fee. You need a CAS (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies) for your visa. This is the electronic letter your university issues.

For the visa steps, read the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide). To plan the whole budget, use the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

## Funding

Southampton's **Dean of the Faculty of Engineering and Physical Sciences Global Talent Award** is worth **£10,000** off tuition. It is competitive, not automatic. Up to 5 awards are available across several schools, and 2 are for Electronics and Computer Science.

- **Deadline:** 30 April 2027, 5pm UK time.
- **Who can apply:** a permanent resident of an eligible country (India is on the list), self-funded and paying overseas fees, holding an offer for an eligible programme and exceeding the entry requirements.
- **Open question:** the page names schools, not courses, so it does not confirm that this course qualifies.

See the [award page](https://www.southampton.ac.uk/study/fees-funding/scholarships/engineering-physical-science-global). The main total does not count the award. If you won it, the first-year total would fall to **£39,061**.

Southampton graduates could also get a 10% discount on postgraduate tuition.

## Deadlines and intakes

International applicants must apply by **Wednesday 18 August 2027**, midday UK time. UK students have until Wednesday 1 September 2027. Southampton warns that applications may close earlier if places fill, so apply early. The Global Talent Award closes earlier, on **30 April 2027**. The page shows September 2027 only, so a January start is not confirmed.

## How to apply

1. **Check the entry rules.** You need a 2:1 equivalent in a related subject plus a programming module and a maths module.
2. **Apply online.** Use the apply button on the [course page](https://www.southampton.ac.uk/courses/data-science-masters-msc). Create an account and upload your documents. Apply before **18 August 2027**.
3. **Send your documents.** Include proof of your first degree, your IELTS score and a personal statement.
4. **Accept your offer and pay the deposit.** Pay **£2,000** before your CAS is issued. Apply for the Global Talent Award by **30 April 2027**.
5. **Check ATAS.** Ask the admissions team if the course needs an ATAS certificate.
6. **Apply for your visa.** You need your CAS, a current passport, proof of funds and your tuberculosis (TB) test result. India is on the UK's TB test list. The test must be at a clinic approved by the Home Office. Read the [TB test page](https://www.gov.uk/tb-test-visa/countries-where-you-need-a-tb-test-to-enter-the-uk) and the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide).

## After the programme

- **Work in the UK after your course.** The Graduate Route lets you stay and work in the UK after your studies. The visa lasts **2 years** if you apply on or before **31 December 2026**, and **18 months** if you apply on or after **1 January 2027**. A September 2027 student applies in 2028, so expect 18 months. The application fee is **£937**.


## Who it suits

**This programme is a strong choice if:**

- you have a computing, maths, statistics or physics degree with programming and maths modules
- your marks meet the 55-65% range for your institution tier
- you want a broad data science course with machine learning and visualisation

**Think carefully if:**

- your degree is in an unrelated subject, because this course needs a related background
- you need a January start, because only September 2027 is shown
- you are not sure of your institution's tier, so check Southampton's list first

faq_json.q: How much does the Southampton MSc Data Science cost for Indian students?
faq_json.a: Tuition is £36,800 for the 2027 entry year. With visa living money, the visa fee and the health surcharge, the first year comes to £49,061 before any scholarship.

faq_json.q: What percentage do Indian students need for Southampton Data Science?
faq_json.a: Southampton asks for a UK 2:1 equivalent of 55% to 65%, depending on the institution. A 2:1 is 60% at a Tier 1 institution, 65% at Tier 2 and 70% at Tier 3.

faq_json.q: Does Southampton need GRE for MSc Data Science?
faq_json.a: The course page does not mention GRE. It asks for IELTS 6.5 overall with 6.0 in each part and a personal statement.

faq_json.q: What is the deadline for Southampton MSc Data Science 2027?
faq_json.a: International applicants must apply by Wednesday 18 August 2027, midday UK time. Applications may close earlier if places fill.

faq_json.q: Is there a scholarship for Indian students at Southampton?
faq_json.a: The Dean's Global Talent Award gives £10,000 off tuition and closes on 30 April 2027. It is competitive, and the page does not confirm that this course qualifies.
